sources.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
sources.titleEn: The Era of Atomic Scale Engineering
sources.scope: 本課「兩奈米以下製程架構」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
sources.scopeEn: Related background for Sub-2 nm Process Architectures. Background on atomic-scale deposition and etch; use the course technical references for detailed mechanisms. It is not footage of every step in this course.

videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.
videos.scope: 本課「金屬閘極功函數工程」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Metal-gate work-function engineering. Background on atomic-scale deposition and etch; use the course technical references for detailed mechanisms. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: The Era of Atomic Scale Engineering
videos.originalTitle: The Era of Atomic Scale Engineering
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「定義真空功函數」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Define vacuum work function requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「區域保護層」列為查證任務：檢查結果是否能支持「選擇處理一種元件時需保護另一種閘堆疊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Plan regional protection: Check whether the evidence supports: Processing one device polarity requires protecting the other stack. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
videos.rights: Official external player/link only. Copyright remains with the publisher. No download, clipping, transcript or rehosting license is claimed.

related.transfer: 功函數材料需同時適合高介電界面及奈米片狹窄空間。
related.transferEn: Work-function materials must suit high-k interfaces and narrow nanosheet gaps.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充；「高介電常數原子層沉積」則以EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill; High-k atomic layer deposition treats eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出金屬閘極功函數工程與高介電常數原子層沉積之間的材料或資料交接
用「定義真空功函數」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充的觀察，說明還需哪個高介電常數原子層沉積證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Metal-gate work-function engineering and High-k atomic layer deposition
Use define vacuum work function to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill and state which additional High-k atomic layer deposition evidence is needed for acceptance
related.title: 高介電常數原子層沉積

related.difference: 本課驗收重點是有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充；「環繞閘極奈米片電晶體」則以片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill; Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors treats inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
practice: 畫出金屬閘極功函數工程與環繞閘極奈米片電晶體之間的材料或資料交接
用「薄金屬連續性」作為兩課比較起點，列出一項相同與一項不同邊界
選一項有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充的觀察，說明還需哪個環繞閘極奈米片電晶體證據才可放行
practiceEn: Draw the material or data handoff between Metal-gate work-function engineering and Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors
Use assess thin-metal continuity to identify one shared and one different boundary
Choose an observation from effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill and state which additional Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors evidence is needed for acceptance
